SELECT id, default_fan_daily_cap FROM girls WHERE id = '{{ $('setFields').item.json.igAccountId }}';

INSERT INTO conversations (fan_id, girl_id, last_message_at)
VALUES (
  '{{ $('setFields').item.json.otherPartyId }}',
  '{{ $('updateGirls').item.json.id }}',
  now()
)
ON CONFLICT (fan_id) DO UPDATE
  SET last_message_at = CASE
    WHEN '{{ $('setFields').item.json.role }}' = 'fan' THEN now()
    ELSE conversations.last_message_at
  END;

INSERT INTO messages (conversation_id, role, content, platform_message_id, created_at)
VALUES (
  '{{ $('setFields').item.json.otherPartyId }}',
  '{{ $('setFields').item.json.role }}',
  '{{ $('setFields').item.json.text.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ $('setFields').item.json.mid }}',
  to_timestamp({{ $('setFields').item.json.eventTimestamp }}::bigint / 1000.0)
)
ON CONFLICT (platform_message_id) DO NOTHING;

INSERT INTO fans (fan_id, girl_id, daily_reply_cap, replies_today_date)
VALUES (
  '{{ $('setFields').item.json.otherPartyId }}',
  '{{ $('updateGirls').item.json.id }}',
  {{ $('updateGirls').item.json.default_fan_daily_cap }},
  CURRENT_DATE
)
ON CONFLICT (fan_id) DO NOTHING;

SELECT f.fan_id, f.girl_id, f.summary_text, f.last_summarized_at
FROM fans f
WHERE f.label IS DISTINCT FROM 'spam'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM messages m
    WHERE m.conversation_id = f.fan_id
      AND m.created_at > COALESCE(f.last_summarized_at, '1970-01-01'::timestamptz)
  )
  AND (f.last_summarized_at IS NULL OR f.last_summarized_at <= now() - interval '4 hours');

SELECT m.role, m.content, m.created_at,
       f.fan_id, f.girl_id, f.summary_text, f.last_summarized_at
FROM messages m
JOIN fans f ON f.fan_id = m.conversation_id
WHERE m.conversation_id = '{{ $json.fan_id }}'
  AND m.created_at > COALESCE({{ $json.last_summarized_at ? `'${$json.last_summarized_at}'::timestamptz` : 'NULL' }}, '1970-01-01'::timestamptz)
ORDER BY m.created_at ASC
LIMIT 200;

UPDATE fans
SET summary_text = '{{ $json.summary.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    last_summarized_at = '{{ $json.lastProcessedAt }}'::timestamptz,
    fan_name = COALESCE(fan_name, {{ $json.detectedName ? `'${$json.detectedName.replace(/'/g, "''")}'` : 'NULL' }})
WHERE fan_id = '{{ $json.fan_id }}';

options.systemMessage:
=You are a conversation summarization assistant. You maintain concise, factual internal notes about individual fans messaging an Instagram persona. This is backend record-keeping, not a customer-facing message ? do not write in the persona's voice or tone.

Given an existing summary (if any) and a batch of new messages, produce an updated summary that:
- Merges the new messages into the existing summary rather than starting over from scratch
- Preserves: the fan's name if mentioned, stated preferences or interests, any promises or commitments made by either side, subscription/purchase intent or status, and the general relationship stage (new, casual, engaged, cooling off)
- Stays under roughly 150 words
- Uses plain, neutral, factual language
- If the fan's name appears anywhere in the new messages and wasn't already known, end your response with a final line formatted exactly as: Name: <name>
- If no name is found or it's already known, omit that line entirely
- Output only the summary text itself ? no preamble, no headers, no explanation
- Only extract a name from messages authored by the fan (role "Fan"), when the fan is stating their own name. Never extract or output the persona's own name (e.g. Maeve, Elara, Amara) as the fan's name, even if it appears in the conversation.

parameters.query:
SELECT
  f.summary_text, f.fan_name, f.fan_nick,
  g.name AS girl_name, g.surname, g.age, g.height_m, g.country, g.religion,
  g.hair, g.eyes, g.skin, g.breasts, g.accessories, g.lips,
  g.personality, g.interests
FROM fans f JOIN girls g ON g.id = f.girl_id
WHERE f.fan_id = '{{ $('setFields').item.json.otherPartyId }}';

SELECT role, content, created_at FROM (
  SELECT role, content, created_at FROM messages
  WHERE conversation_id = '{{ $('setFields').item.json.otherPartyId }}'
  ORDER BY created_at DESC
  LIMIT 12
) recent
ORDER BY created_at ASC;

  relname AS table_name,

FROM pg_catalog.pg_statio_user_tables
ORDER BY pg_total_relation_size(relid) DESC;
